note: Round-2 queue rulings that a LATER owner ruling overrides. Read by lib/queueRulings.mjs, which drops them before any materialiser sees them, so all six sections honour one list. Round 2's own record is NOT edited: audit/unhighlighted-owner-rulings-2.json stays the account of what was ruled on 2026-08-24, and this file is the account of what was ruled about it afterwards.
why: A withdrawal cannot be a deletion from the round-2 artifact. That artifact is the evidence of a review; editing it would make the correction invisible and make the round unreproducible. It also cannot be a per-materialiser exclusion — six materialisers read the rulings and a second copy of the list is the failure lib/queueRulings.mjs exists to prevent.
